summary: Most of the frustration centres on data loss and stability, followed by mobile app usability and ai integration concerns. Users report sudden data loss, workspace suspension, and instability, especially with AI integration, leading to frustration and distrust in data security and reliability.

themes.name: Learning Curve and Complexity
themes.description: Users find Notion complex and difficult to navigate, especially on mobile, which deters adoption and leads to frustration with its steep learning curve.
themes.recommendation: Simplify onboarding, improve mobile UX, and provide more intuitive guidance for new users.

themes.name: Mobile App Usability
themes.description: Users find the mobile app clunky, buggy, and lacking key features like sidebar controls and widget support, which hinders productivity on mobile devices.
themes.recommendation: Prioritize mobile app performance, usability, and feature parity with desktop versions.

themes.name: AI Integration Concerns
themes.description: Users are frustrated with AI features that are inconsistent, unreliable, and sometimes lock users out of core functionality, raising concerns about dependency and control.
themes.recommendation: Refine AI features for consistency and reliability, and provide clear opt-out options for users who prefer not to rely on AI.

themes.name: Privacy and Cost Concerns
themes.description: Users express growing concerns about privacy, cost, and the increasing reliance on paid features, which they feel are becoming a barrier to continued use.
themes.recommendation: Offer more transparent pricing models, enhance privacy controls, and consider free tiers for core functionality.

themes.name: Data Loss and Stability
themes.description: Users report sudden data loss, workspace suspension, and instability, especially with AI integration, leading to frustration and distrust in data security and reliability.
themes.recommendation: Improve data backup and recovery mechanisms, enhance AI integration stability, and provide clearer communication during data-related incidents.

themes.name: Feature Limitations
themes.description: Users report missing features like advanced widgets, color customization, and improved mobile functionality, which limit the app's utility for certain workflows.
themes.recommendation: Expand feature set, especially on mobile, and prioritize user feedback for new functionality.

themes.name: User Experience and Performance
themes.description: Users report performance issues like lag, crashes, and poor integration with external tools, which negatively impact the overall user experience.
themes.recommendation: Optimize app performance, improve integration with external tools, and address known bugs.
